children: Plutonian Acquisition Corp. II entered a definitive business combination agreement with NT1, providing a path to a NYSE-listed combined company and valuing NT1 at an estimated $500 million.
Plutonian Acquisition Corp. II and NT1 signed a merger and business combination agreement to form a combined company to be listed on the NYSE.
Terms provide NT1 shareholders purchaser shares valued at $10.00 each, implying an estimated NT1 enterprise value of $500 million.
Transaction expected to close in 2027, subject to regulatory and shareholder approvals and customary closing conditions.
NT1 will retain current management and plans to accelerate exploration and expand its mineral portfolio in Australia post-combination.
The combined company will file a Form F-4 registration statement and definitive proxy/prospectus for shareholder votes and securities offering.
